"""
    _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String) -> Tuple{Vector{Float64}, Vector{Float64}, Vector{Float64}, Int, Int, Int}

Private function to load grid data from file.

# Arguments
- `grid_file_path::String`: Path to the grid file

# Returns
- Tuple containing:
  - x coordinates
  - y coordinates
  - z coordinates
  - nx (number of points in x direction)
  - ny (number of points in y direction)
  - nz (number of points in z direction)
"""
function _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String)
    h5open(grid_file_path, "r") do file
        coordinates = file["coordinates"]
        x = read(coordinates["x"])
        y = read(coordinates["y"])
        z = read(coordinates["z"])

        nx = read(file["metadata/dimensions/nx"])
        ny = read(file["metadata/dimensions/ny"])
        nz = read(file["metadata/dimensions/nz"])

        return x, y, z, nx, ny, nz
    end
end

"""
    _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String) -> Tuple{Vector{Point3f}, Int, Int, Int}

Private function to load grid data from file.

# Arguments
- `grid_file_path::String`: Path to the grid file

# Returns
- Tuple containing:
  - xyz coordinates as Vector{Point3f}
  - nx (number of points in x direction)
  - ny (number of points in y direction)
  - nz (number of points in z direction)
"""
function _get_grid_data(grid_file_path::String)
    h5open(grid_file_path, "r") do file
        coordinates = file["coordinates"]
        x = read(coordinates["x"])
        y = read(coordinates["y"])
        z = read(coordinates["z"])

        nx = read(file["metadata/dimensions/nx"])
        ny = read(file["metadata/dimensions/ny"])
        nz = read(file["metadata/dimensions/nz"])

        # Combine into Vector{Point3f}
        xyz = Point3f.(x, y, z)

        return xyz, nx, ny, nz
    end
end
